data.body: Investigation complete (BASIC). Root cause: Finding IDs never assigned — agent prompts don't include finding_id in output schema, no pipeline step generates them. Fallback produces 'unknown-{cycle}-{idx}'. When schema doc is in context, LLM copies example value f-a1b2c3d4 verbatim. Fix: add content-hash-based ID generation step in runner.py before telemetry emission.
